comment: The jump buttons act at once (src/SomeStructure.cpp:475-480), where the maker's README says they wait for the next bar boundary. The style category switch is configured Organic, Electronic, Custom (src/SomeStructure.cpp:301) with Electronic as the default, and the panel prints them CUSTOM, ELEC., ORG. from the top down. The blur calculation uses the C library's own rand() rather than a seeded generator (src/SomeStructure.cpp:510). A section whose duration is set to Skip is stepped over by a recursive call, so eight sections all set to Skip would recurse without end.
